, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly compared the directors’ birthdates by month/day within a calendar year, ignoring the different years (1938 vs 1965). This led to the false conclusion that Boaz Yakin (1965) was born before Pupi Avati (1938), when in fact 1938 is earlier.
